platform: Apple M4 Pro, macOS arm64, one thread
scope: Pure native LOWER of proven total integer/BOOLEAN-to-unbounded-STRING casts on both released lines and of qualified primitive ASCII PRINTF on Flink 2.2. Excludes literal I in formatter output to preserve Java locale/cache behavior. No runtime rebuild, transport change or new configuration.

method.input: Equal prepared GenericRowData/BinaryRowData and Arrow; both NULL modes; signed integer extrema and BOOLEAN, including modern and legacy Boolean text and qualified literal/indexed/precision/padded PRINTF.
method.native_timer: Starts/stops inside Rust after import and before export, retaining production Calc, output consumption, allocation, conversions and intrinsic callbacks. Initial JNI/import/export and perimeter transposes are outside this prepared operation only.
method.previous: The actual preceding encoder/helper from the recorded previous head runs the identical fixture/data/JDK on its saved whole DSO/executable. The candidate runtime artifacts are byte-identical because this extension changes Java admission only. Both paths require consumed operation; only the new route requires empty evaluators.
method.pipeline: Eight million-row bounded row-source to blackhole configurations, one thread, two warmups and five alternating stock/native measurements. Job submission/startup, JNI and both perimeter RowData/Arrow transposes are retained. Setup and surrounding JVM process startup are outside the job timer.

before_observation: Per JDK: Flink 2.2 compares thirteen complete first-query maps/schema and the first locale query before fourteen intended evaluator-route failures; Flink 1.18 compares ten complete first-query maps/schema and the first locale query before eleven intended route failures. Later modern/legacy/empty queries in failing invocations are not reached. Two residual/catalog control methods per release/JDK pass.

native_runtime_qualification.method: No native source/build change. The exact frozen DSO/executable retain their archived 912-core-test qualification; those are not new Rust runs. Fresh JVM/SQL, four unchanged released casing stock-oracle invocations and performance controls use that exact runtime.

limitations: General STRING/Unicode, cache-sensitive locales and consumers, bounded text casts and failing/unverified producers keep their existing routes. No generic string representation guard is removed.
Only qualified primitive ASCII PRINTF participates on Flink 2.2; Flink 1.18 does not provide PRINTF. The literal excludes locale-sensitive i/I as appropriate independently of the planner JVM locale.
All sixteen-row controls, independent stock drift, ranges and whole-job results are retained. Prepared bulk qualification does not establish universal whole-job acceleration.
Focused local verification is distinct from full hosted suites, which must qualify the exact pushed head.
